title: Kafka Producer: report.filed — Retry + Dead Letter Handling
last_note: Extracted publishWithRetry(report) with 3-attempt loop (200ms/400ms exponential backoff, no sleep after final attempt). Success path unchanged (updateFirst stamps outboxPublishedAt). Exhausted-retry path logs ERROR with marker DEAD_LETTER_REPORT_FILED including reportId, reportedId, full eventPayload, attempt count, and exception; outboxPublishedAt left null so next 500ms tick retries naturally. No new topic, enum, or Mongo field added; ReportController/ReportServiceImpl untouched so POST /reports still returns 201 synchronously before the relay ever runs.
